title: Hangboard Isometric Holds
texts: A max hang style workout designed for climbers building up to body weight hangs

A max hang workout whilst keeping your feet on the floor. Please make sure to warm up on larger holds before starting this workout.

This is designed to increase strength in your fingers and forearms without needing a pulley and weights for assistance. The stimulus is the same as a max hang workout but more useful for climbers who find 2 arm body weight hangs close to their max. This protocol uses one arm holds instead of two in order to help manage the load more easily on each arm.

Choose a comfortable 18-22mm edge for this workout. On each set, hold the edge with one hand using your preferred grip position. Without letting your feet leave the ground, bend your legs to slowly weight the hangboard until it you are applying a challenging force through your fingers. This means you are trying hard to hold on but without reaching a maximum effort. Hold this force for the set time before standing up to reduce the force placed through your fingers, releasing your grip and relaxing for the rest period. Switch hands for the 2nd rep of the set

Complete 5 sets of 7 second hangs with 1 minute rest between hangs on the same arm and 30 seconds between hangs on the opposite arm.
